claims.name: frame-complete
claims.risk: the idea was taken on with no frame, or with a frame that leaves out the outcome, what people do today, the appetite, the no-gos, the bar for a first version, ranked assumptions, a stop rule or the strongest case against

claims.name: appetite-asked-or-flagged
claims.risk: the appetite stands as the person's in the frame, though nobody gave it and the answer does not ask for it

claims.name: questions-bear-on-a-decision
claims.risk: the person was asked a question that names no decision their answer would change

claims.name: recommendation-named
claims.risk: the answer does not recommend building, probing first or stopping

claims.name: nothing-built-beyond-a-probe
claims.risk: application code, a dependency manifest or a CI file was written before any assumption was probed, or probe code left the working area or is not marked as throwaway
